observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a transmission housing with a torque converter visible inside, mounted on a stand. The housing has bolt holes and fluid lines attached.
Photo 1 shows the side of the transmission housing, which is dusty and has some red paint marks. A white slip-on shoe with 'Angel' written on it is visible in the background.

Photo 2 shows the internal components of the transmission: the input shaft, clutch plate, and torque converter. The housing is open, revealing the gears and bearings. The torque converter has a blue circle marking on it.
All photos show a used, second-hand transmission with visible wear, oil residue, and dirt. No visible branding or model numbers are readable on the housing or internal components.
The seller claims it is a 'Complete gearbox M272'.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number M272 on the housing or internal components in any photo. The term 'M272' is not readable in any image.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be M272 as claimed, or may be a different model or brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission housing or internal components showing the model number or brand name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic complete gearbox without model-specific value.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be damaged internally or have worn components not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the internal gears, bearings, and clutch plate in motion, or a close-up of the input shaft and torque converter under load.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or requiring major repairs.

risks.risk: The gearbox may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the transmission's serial number and any damage indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used unit with unknown history.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the transmission housing showing any model number or brand name.
A video or photo showing the internal components (gears, bearings, clutch plate) in motion or under load.
A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or any damage indicators on the transmission.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
